title: MapleStory Idle RPG Experience Guide
author: MapleStory Idle RPG Wiki contributors
summary: A leveling reference comparing online, sleep-mode, and offline progression, with experience requirements and a practical kill-rate test for choosing a farming method.

sections.title: Experience sources
items: Online and sleep-mode play use active hunting behavior.
Offline progression follows its own reward and time-cap rules.

sections.title: Efficiency check
items: Measure actual kills per minute on the current map.
Compare online output with the offline estimate instead of assuming one is always superior.

sections.title: Level planning
items: Use the experience table to understand the next requirement jump.
Recalculate after changing jobs, skills, equipment, or maps.

notes: Community-wiki values can change with balance patches; use the linked calculator for current estimates.
steps: Record the current level and EXP.
Move to a better stage when kill efficiency falls.
